name: 101 Blessings for Nurses Scripture Card Box
metaDescription: A boxed set of 101 scripture cards for nurses. A gentle, budget friendly gift for a nurse of faith who could use encouragement on hard shifts.
summary: A box of 101 scripture cards for nurses, meant to be kept close or passed along to someone who needs a lift.
whyItWorks: Nursing can be draining in a way that is hard to explain to people outside the job. Long shifts, tough patient outcomes, and the emotional weight of caring for families add up. For a nurse whose faith matters to them, a set of short scripture cards can offer a quiet moment before clocking in or a bit of comfort on the drive home. The title says these are meant to keep or share, which suits nurses well, since many of them are the kind of people who pass encouragement on to coworkers.

A card box is also easy to fit into real life. One can live in a badge holder, a locker, or a car visor, and the rest can stay on a nightstand. For a pinning ceremony, graduation, or a new job, it makes a thoughtful companion to a card from you. It is a budget friendly gift that still feels meaningful, as long as you know the recipient will welcome a faith based message.
goodToKnow: Only give this to someone you know appreciates scripture, since the content is explicitly religious.
It is listed as a hardcover box set, so it works well as a keepsake on a desk or shelf.
Add a handwritten note with a favorite verse of your own to make it more personal.

faq.q: Is this a good pinning ceremony gift?
faq.a: It can be, especially for a Christian nursing graduate. It pairs nicely with a more practical gift like a badge reel or a pen set.

faq.q: Can the cards be shared with coworkers?
faq.a: Yes. The set is described as cards to keep or share, so a nurse can hand one to a coworker who is having a rough day.
